title: Grade 2 Science — Fri, Jun 20
description: Our Food — Day 5 of 5: Mixed review — food sources, taste, healthy eating
subject: science

questions.question: Name a food that comes from a plant AND a food that comes from an animal:
questions.explanation: Rice comes from the rice plant (seed). Eggs come from hens (animals). Both are common, nutritious foods.

questions.question: Which part of the plant do we eat when we eat wheat chapati?
questions.explanation: Wheat grains are seeds. Chapati flour is made by grinding wheat seeds.

questions.question: Lemon tastes ___. Sugar tastes ___. Salt tastes ___.
questions.explanation: Lemon = sour; Sugar = sweet; Salt = salty. These are three of the five basic tastes.

questions.question: Milk is an animal food product. Which of these is made from milk?
questions.explanation: Curd (dahi) is made from milk — a classic Indian milk product. Also: butter, ghee, paneer, cheese.

questions.question: Which of these is a leafy vegetable?
questions.explanation: Spinach (palak) is a leafy vegetable. We eat its leaves. Mango is a fruit, carrot is a root, potato is a stem.

questions.question: Why do we need to eat a VARIETY of foods?
options: Because different foods give different nutrients our body needs
Because one food has all nutrients
questions.explanation: No single food has all the nutrients we need. Eating a variety ensures we get carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals.

questions.question: Honey is made by bees from:
questions.explanation: Bees collect nectar from flowers and convert it into honey inside the beehive. Honey is a natural sweetener.

questions.question: Which of these is a junk food?
questions.explanation: Fried chips are junk food — they have too much oil and salt and very few nutrients.

questions.question: Match the food to its source: Egg → ___, Mango → ___, Milk → ___
questions.explanation: Egg → hen; Mango → mango tree; Milk → cow (also buffalo, goat).

questions.question: The tongue helps us taste. The nose helps us:
options: Smell food (which adds to the taste experience)
questions.explanation: The nose helps us smell food. Smell and taste together give us the full flavour experience.

questions.question: Which two foods are both from plants?
questions.explanation: Rice and wheat are both grains — seeds of grass plants. Egg and milk come from animals.

questions.question: Pulses (like moong, chana, masoor) are important because they give us:
questions.explanation: Pulses (dal) are rich in protein. Protein helps build muscles and repair the body. They are called body-building foods.

questions.question: Which habit keeps food safe to eat?
options: Leaving cooked food open in the sun
Covering food and storing it properly
questions.explanation: Covering and properly storing food prevents it from being contaminated by flies, dust, and bacteria.

questions.question: An omnivore is an animal that eats:
questions.explanation: Omnivores eat both plant and animal food. Humans are omnivores. Bears, crows, and dogs are also omnivores.

questions.question: What is the BEST drink for our body every day?
questions.explanation: Water is the best drink. Our body needs 6–8 glasses daily to stay hydrated, digest food, and flush out waste.
